jobs.alt: A process review workspace with a printed workflow, practical checklist and laptop.
jobs.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create a premium natural editorial photograph for a Solvero business-improvement consultancy homepage. Landscape 3:2, approximately 1536x1024. Soft directional window daylight, neutral off-white, warm grey and light timber palette with restrained blue accents inspired by #1985CE and #35B0ED. Real paper, fabric and material texture, believable perspective, moderate depth of field. Calm, practical, credible professional work setting. Clear simple composition that remains understandable as a small website card; meaningful subject inside a central crop-safe area. No recognisable faces or likeness of the business owner. No stock-model posing, handshake, cash piles, coins, skyscrapers, robots, floating graphics, neon tech, trophies, certificate seals, watermark, logo, overlaid headline, caption, footer or caveat. No invented performance figures, confidential information, client names, or screenshots pretending to be a real system. All work materials are generic illustrative examples.
Primary scene: photograph a modest contemporary process-review workspace from a gently elevated three-quarter angle. A flat A3 process map is the focal point on a tidy timber meeting table. The sheet has only a small number of clear rectangular steps joined by arrows with subtle blue highlights. One section is being reviewed with an ordinary pen held by a naturally positioned hand entering from outside the crop; only the hand and a small portion of a neat long sleeve are visible, no person or face. Beside it is a short action checklist in an open notebook, and a slim laptop sits toward the rear with its screen turned away and softly out of focus. A second clear sheet with a simplified route is nearby, suggesting moving from investigation into a practical solution, without a prominent before/after graphic. A restrained blue mug at the edge. Natural purposeful working scene, no excessive stationery or scattered sticky notes. Keep the process map recognisable but its small annotations unobtrusive and non-readable. This About image should communicate practical analysis and delivery, not a personal portrait or generic empty office.

jobs.alt: Corporate credit and credit-risk working papers beside an insurance policy administration folder.
jobs.purpose: Shows corporate lending, credit risk and insurance policy administration as specific financial-services disciplines.
jobs.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. Generate a professional editorial PHOTOGRAPH for a business-improvement and solution-delivery consultancy homepage. Landscape 3:2, 1536x1024. Soft natural window daylight, real paper and materials, understated neutral grey and light timber with restrained blue accents #1985CE and #35B0ED. The picture must visually explain the specific expertise named below and remain legible as a small website image. Credible modest professional workspace, clear crop-safe central composition. No recognisable faces, personal likeness, logos, invented client results, performance figures, badges, certification seals, watermark, overlaid headline, footer or caveat. No handshakes, generic smiling stock team, coins, skyscrapers, floating graphics, glowing technology or robots. All diagrams must be actual markings on physical paper or a board within the photographed scene, never a floating digital overlay.
Primary scene: a close, natural three-quarter photograph of a specialist financial-services analysis desk. The focal working folder is labelled exactly "Corporate credit". It contains a clear paper headed "Credit risk" with three neatly separated sections labelled "Exposure", "Expected credit loss", and "Economic capital". These are review topics, not a formula or causal flow; use only short grey placeholder lines, no numbers, percentage charts or invented financial calculations. Behind it sits a second slim blue working folder labelled exactly "Policy administration", visibly representing the insurance domain without competing for attention. A cropped hand with a pen rests beside the credit-risk document as if reviewing system requirements, and a normal laptop keyboard is softly out of focus at one rear edge. Show realistic high-quality paper, dividers and subtle natural shadows. Make the Corporate credit and Credit risk headings the clearest focal details; the secondary policy folder supports the banking-and-insurance context. Avoid generic onboarding forms, generic approvals checklists, audit stamps, payment cards, cash, calculators, bank seals, passports or ID documents. This image represents banking credit and insurance systems expertise, not administrative tasks common to all businesses.

jobs.purpose: Shows application integration across different systems, with shared master data as one supported initiative.

Primary scene: a convincing real photograph of a small systems-integration design workshop, with an upright physical whiteboard in sharp focus and a slim laptop partly visible on the table below. The board contains a clean professionally hand-drawn application map: three distinct application boxes labelled exactly "CRM", "ERP", and "Legacy", arranged around a central blue-accented box labelled "Integration". Natural photographic materials and perspective, subtle office background. This is a tangible design artefact about connecting disparate business applications and controlling shared information, not three duplicate customer folders, a network cabling installation, or an invented product screenshot.

jobs.alt: A workshop compares the current process with a proposed simpler route while retaining a review step.
jobs.purpose: Shows deliberate process redesign and fewer unnecessary handoffs, rather than visibility of a queue alone.
jobs.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. Generate a professional editorial PHOTOGRAPH for a business-improvement and solution-delivery consultancy homepage. Landscape 3:2, 1536x1024. Soft natural window daylight, real paper and materials, understated neutral grey and light timber with restrained blue accents #1985CE and #35B0ED. The picture must visually explain the specific expertise named below and remain legible as a small website image. Credible modest professional workspace, clear crop-safe central composition. No recognisable faces, personal likeness, logos, invented client results, performance figures, badges, certification seals, watermark, overlaid headline, footer or caveat. No handshakes, generic smiling stock team, coins, skyscrapers, floating graphics, glowing technology or robots. Primary scene: an elevated three-quarter photograph of practical business-process redesign on a tidy meeting table. Two large flat working sheets sit side by side, labelled exactly "Current process" and "Proposed process". On Current process, real movable blue and grey rectangular paper cards form a winding route with several handoffs and one clearly visible return loop. On Proposed process, fewer well-spaced cards form a more direct route with simple connecting arrows and a retained explicit card labelled "Review". These represent design alternatives, not measured client outcomes. A cropped hand is repositioning one card on the Proposed process sheet while another plain pen lies near the removed redundant card at the side. Only a few cards, clean uncluttered scene, no dense labels, no metrics, percentages or promises. Use realistic physical paper and ink, with distinct natural card-edge shadows. Keep the difference between the two routes immediately understandable at website-card size. A blue notebook and a softly blurred laptop may sit at the edge, without dominating the scene. No waiting/complete kanban columns or queue-only board: the specific point is changing the way work is organised and testing a clearer process, not just seeing where it waits.
